statement: Justice Monument is the new Cavern 10 bonus monument released in the update; caverns previously went 1 to 9.
AFK also works for the Justice Monument just like Bravery; summoning bonuses apply.
You act as judge hearing NPC pleas and can bribe or trade or get free things depending on case progress and RNG.
You have three choices per case: approve; reject; dismiss.
Dismiss is a get-out-of-jail-free card usable a limited number of times; he currently has only one use.
Read each case as you run it because riddles and investments can benefit you.
Some bribes double your money later if you give money now; investments come from the LLC boss.
Royal Court Case shows how far you are into the run.
Retirement Chests are obtained at the end of the run to choose bonuses; getting them throughout the run is a necessity.
Life bar is Mental Health; at zero the run ends and you choose Retirement Chest bonuses.
Royal Court Coffer holds your coins; coins are the main currency used for trades and buying popularity or hearts.
Popularity is also a currency; coins and popularity can be swapped and Mental Hearts can also be traded.
Two main currencies are popularity and coins.
Unsure whether increased popularity affects how good trades are; only day one.
Fizarre Drink: for money he stops your popularity from dropping below a certain level.
Timmy (Ohio Skibby) NPC is annoying; minus one for Lava.
Grumblo gives a free gift in exchange for coins; it can be many things including a Retirement Chest.
Suggests spending the money on Grumblo's gift if you can afford it.
Death the Harbinger appears every five rounds in some variations; pay set coins to continue or lose a heart.
In later levels if you still have dismiss you can dismiss Harbinger to save a heart when short on coins.
Retirement Jester exchanges coins or popularity for a Retirement Chest.
Retirement Chests are something to prioritize.
Mr. Bribe exchanges coins for chance at popularity or popularity for chance at coins; maybe hearts.
Head honcho of Big Biz LLC offers investments: pay set coins and later get more; pays back tenfold if you hold out.
Investing is risky because if you lack coins for the Harbinger it gets dicey.
Cool Bird is a gamble NPC: chance to win or lose coins; popularity; or mental hearts.
Gambling with Cool Bird mostly lost; odds feel rigged and not 50/50; do at own discretion.
Accepting or rejecting NPC deals changes popularity; accepting head honcho's investment loses popularity.
Scripticus usually gives a big popularity bonus for coins; free way to get popularity.
King Bean (Esquire Bored Bean) sometimes offers a trade or riddle; dismiss him for free Retirement Chest from riddle.
Do not accept or reject the riddle; dismiss.
Reanimated Hand usually requires giving up a heart in return for coins.
Ghost NPC scares people and gives coins; unsure.
Good Death (Grateful Bringer) gives a flower; five coins; and a Retirement Chest.
Bonuses include artifact chance; XP for villagers; Essence Opals and more.
The essence bonus from this is a true multiplier so big gains.
Free-to-play players probably haven't unlocked Justice Monument yet.
Likes Justice Monument; full god run video available to learn from.
Get the key chance from the limited-time shop if you want.
